title: View file envelope
description: The seven top-level fields every view file carries. A kind's own schema governs payload.

kind_version.description: The version of the kind's payload schema.

subject.description: The identity the file is about, or null for a per-checkout kind.

stamp.description: Which commit the file describes and what produced it.

commit.description: The checkout's HEAD when the generator ran.

generated_at.description: When the generator ran, UTC RFC 3339 with a Z suffix.

generator.description: The module that wrote the file.

payload.description: The object the kind's schema governs.
